149: /-- Quotient rule for `Time.deriv` on real-valued functions: if `c` and `g` are
150:   differentiable at `t` and `g t ≠ 0`, then
151:   `∂ₜ (c / g) t = (∂ₜ c t * g t - c t * ∂ₜ g t) / (g t)^2`. -/
152: lemma deriv_div {c g : Time → ℝ}
153:     (hc : DifferentiableAt ℝ c t) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g t) (hgz : g t ≠ 0) :
154:     ∂ₜ (fun s => c s / g s) t =
155:       (∂ₜ c t * g t - c t * ∂ₜ g t) / (g t) ^ 2 := by
156:   repeat rw [Time.deriv_eq]
157:   ring_nf

163:     (f1 f2 : Space d → M) (hf1 : Differentiable ℝ f1) (hf2 : Differentiable ℝ f2) :
164:     ∂[u] (f1 + f2) = ∂[u] f1 + ∂[u] f2 := by

179:     ∂[u] (f1 - f2) = ∂[u] f1 - ∂[u] f2 := by

{"kind": "source_excerpt", "path": "Physlib/SpaceAndTime/Space/Derivatives/Div.lean", "version": "v4.32.0", "text": "50: /-!
51: 
52: ## A. The divergence on functions
53: 
54: -/
55: 
56: /-- The vector calculus operator `div`. -/
57: noncomputable def div {d} (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
58:     Space d → ℝ := fun x =>
59:   -- get i-th component of `f`
60:   -- derivative of i-th component in i-th coordinate
61:   -- ∂fᵢ/∂xᵢ
62:   ∑ i, ∂[i] (fun x => (f x) i) x
63: 
64: @[inherit_doc div]
65: macro (name := divNotation) "∇" "⬝" f:term:100 : term => `(div $f)
66: 
67: lemma div_eq_sum_fderiv {d} (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
68:     (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (x : Space d) :
69:     (∇ ⬝ f) x = ∑ i, fderiv ℝ f x (basis i) i := by
70:   simp [div, Space.deriv]
71:   congr
72:   funext i
73:   rw [← Space.deriv_eq]
74:   rw [deriv_euclid]
75:   rfl
76:   fun_prop
77: 
78: /-!
79: 
80: ### A.1. The divergence on the zero function
81: 
82: -/
83: 
84: @[simp]
85: lemma div_zero : ∇ ⬝ (0 : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) = 0 := by
86:   unfold div Space.deriv Finset.sum
87:   simp only [Pi.ofNat_apply, fderiv_fun_const, _root_.zero_apply, Multiset.map_const',
88:     Finset.card_val, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Multiset.sum_replicate, smul_zero]
89:   rfl
90: 
91: /-!
92: 
93: ### A.2. The divergence on a constant function
94: 
95: -/
96: 
97: @[simp]
98: lemma div_const : ∇ ⬝ (fun _ : Space d => v) = 0 := by
99:   unfold div Space.deriv Finset.sum
100:   simp only [fderiv_fun_const, Pi.ofNat_apply, _root_.zero_apply, Multiset.map_const',
101:     Finset.card_val, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Multiset.sum_replicate, smul_zero]
102:   rfl
103: 
104: /-!
105: 
106: ### A.3. The divergence distributes over addition
107: 
108: -/
109: 
110: lemma div_add (f1 f2 : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
111:     (hf1 : Differentiable ℝ f1) (hf2 : Differentiable ℝ f2) :
112:     ∇ ⬝ (f1 + f2) = ∇ ⬝ f1 + ∇ ⬝ f2 := by
113:   unfold div
114:   simp only [Pi.add_apply]
115:   funext x
116:   simp only [Pi.add_apply]
117:   rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
118:   congr
119:   funext i
120:   simp [Space.deriv]
121:   rw [fderiv_fun_add]
122:   simp only [_root_.add_apply]
123:   · fun_prop
124:   · fun_prop
125: 
126: /-!
127: 
128: ### A.4. The divergence distributes over scalar multiplication
129: 
130: -/
131: 
132: lemma div_smul (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (k : ℝ)
133:     (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) :
134:     ∇ ⬝ (k • f) = k • ∇ ⬝ f := by
135:   unfold div
136:   simp only [Pi.smul_apply]
137:   funext x
138:   simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
139:   rw [Finset.mul_sum]
140:   congr
141:   funext i
142:   simp [Space.deriv]
143:   rw [fderiv_const_mul]
144:   simp only [FunLike.coe_smul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
145:   · fun_prop
146: 
147: /-!
148: 
149: ### A.5. The divergence of a linear map is a linear map
150: 
151: -/
152: 
153: lemma div_linear_map (f : W → Space 3 → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))
154:     (hf : ∀ w, Differentiable ℝ (f w))
155:     (hf' : IsLinearMap ℝ f) :
156:     IsLinearMap ℝ (fun w => ∇ ⬝ (f w)) := by
157:   constructor
158:   · intro w w'
159:     rw [hf'.map_add]
160:     rw [div_add]
161:     repeat fun_prop
162:   · intros k w
163:     rw [hf'.map_smul]
164:     rw [div_smul]
165:     fun_prop
166: 
167: /-!

121:     (hf : Differentiable ℝ ↿f) :
122:     fderiv ℝ (fun x' => f t x') x dx = fderiv ℝ ↿f (t, x) (0, dx) := by
123:   change fderiv ℝ (↿f ∘ fun x' => (t, x')) x dx = _

131:     (f : Time → Space d → M) (t dt : Time) (x : Space d)
132:     (hf : Differentiable ℝ ↿f) :

143: ### A.3. Commuting time and space derivatives

147: /-- Derivatives along space coordinates and time commute. -/
148: lemma fderiv_time_commute_fderiv_space {M} [NormedAddCommGroup M] [NormedSpace ℝ M]
149:     (f : Time → Space d → M) (t dt : Time) (x dx : Space d)
150:     (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 ↿f) :
151:     fderiv ℝ (fun t' => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => f t' x') x dx) t dt
152:     = fderiv ℝ (fun x' => fderiv ℝ (fun t' => f t' x') t dt) x dx := by
153:   trans fderiv ℝ (fun t' => (fderiv ℝ (↿f) (t', x) (0, dx))) t dt
154:   · congr
155:     funext t'
156:     exact fderiv_space_eq_fderiv_curry f t' x dx (hf.differentiable (by simp))
157:   trans fderiv ℝ (fun x => (fderiv ℝ (↿f) x (0, dx))) (t, x) (dt, 0)
158:   · exact fderiv_time_eq_fderiv_curry (fun t x => fderiv ℝ ↿f (t, x) (0, dx)) t dt x (by fun_prop)
159:   symm
160:   trans fderiv ℝ (fun x' => (fderiv ℝ (↿f) (t, x') (dt, 0))) x dx
161:   · congr
162:     funext x'
163:     exact fderiv_time_eq_fderiv_curry f t dt x' (hf.differentiable (by simp))
164:   trans fderiv ℝ (fun t => (fderiv ℝ (↿f) t (dt, 0))) (t, x) (0, dx)
165:   · exact fderiv_space_eq_fderiv_curry (fun t x => fderiv ℝ ↿f (t, x) (dt, 0)) t x dx (by fun_prop)
166:   rw [fderiv_clm_apply, fderiv_clm_apply]
167:   · simp only [fderiv_fun_const, Pi.zero_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_zero, zero_add,
168:       ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply]
169:     exact (hf.contDiffAt.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp)).eq (0, dx) (dt, 0)
170:   all_goals fun_prop

@[to_fun]
theorem HasFDerivAtFilter.const_smul (h : HasFDerivAtFilter f f' L) (c : R) :
    HasFDerivAtFilter (c • f) (c • f') L :=

    DifferentiableWithinAt 𝕜 (c • f) s x ↔ DifferentiableWithinAt 𝕜 f s x := by

section ConstSMulDivisionRing

variable {R : Type*} [DivisionSemiring R] [Module R F] [SMulCommClass 𝕜 R F]

/-- Special case of `fderivWithin_const_smul_of_invertible` over a division semiring: any constant
is allowed.

TODO: This would work for scalars in a `GroupWithZero` if we had a `DistribMulActionWithZero`
typeclass. -/
lemma fderivWithin_const_smul_field (c : R) (hs : UniqueDiffWithinAt 𝕜 s x) :
    fderivWithin 𝕜 (c • f) s x = c • fderivWithin 𝕜 f s x := by
  obtain (rfl | ha) := eq_or_ne c 0
  · simp
  · have : Invertible c := invertibleOfNonzero ha
    simp [fderivWithin_const_smul_of_invertible c hs]

lemma fderivWithin_const_smul_field' {s : Set 𝕜} {f : 𝕜 → F} {x : 𝕜} (c : R) :
    fderivWithin 𝕜 (c • f) s x = c • fderivWithin 𝕜 f s x := by
  by_cases hsx : UniqueDiffWithinAt 𝕜 s x
  · exact fderivWithin_const_smul_field c hsx
  · simp [fderivWithin_zero_of_not_uniqueDiffWithinAt hsx]

omit [DivisionSemiring R] [Module R F] [SMulCommClass 𝕜 R F] [ContinuousConstSMul R F] in
/-- Special case of `fderivWithin_neg` for functions `𝕜 → F`, i.e. when the domain `E` is the scalar
field `𝕜` itself. In this case no `UniqueDiffWithinAt 𝕜 s x` hypothesis is needed. -/

    fderivWithin 𝕜 (-f) s x = -fderivWithin 𝕜 f s x := by
  simpa only [neg_smul, one_smul] using fderivWithin_const_smul_field' (f := f) (-1 : 𝕜)

typeclass. -/

  simp_rw [← fderivWithin_univ]
